text: x to delete button only works on some pieces places in the build mode in hmsc-int
resolution: Fixed build-mode piece delete/edit scoping for hmsc-int. The bug was that visible pieces can come from either the active map stream or the legacy global pool, but X/E always emitted map-scoped mutations, so legacy-visible pieces stayed standing. Added pieceMutationMapName to resolve the source pool for a visible target, wired PlayRoute and the editor build commit path to use it for pieceRemoved/pieceEditSet, and added REQ-0410 regression coverage. Verified with placed.test and a hmsc-int cart bundle.
